findings.text: the report names .../launch/fenced-summary-nc.json as the control arm's summary and the manifest repeats that path in test_logs and negative_control_log, but no such file exists: this run's driver builds every tagged name from the value passed as FENCED_TAG=-nc, so the control's summary is launch/fenced-summary--nc.json (the single-dash shape belongs to the previous run, whose own file list confirms it), leaving the only pointer to the control's record unresolvable.

guard.guard_decision_key is recorded false while launch/cc-out/bodies/0002.json carries the hook error text with "permissionDecision": "deny" and launch/cc-out/bodies/0003.json through 0005.json carry it too; replaying the driver's own expression at launch/launch_fenced.py:241 over those four bodies returns true, so the stored record reports the guard decision absent at the moment it fired, and the manifest's follow_ons names only the other broken needle.

the landed diff bumps plan-version from 25 to 27, which the source brief's landing contract forbids touching because every worker editing that line makes every merge conflict there; the authoritative main-checkout copy still reads 25, so the landed line carries a two-step bump for one authored change and the worker discloses it only in follow_ons.

the new control bullet states the empty-config arm carries no memory markers, but that arm's own marker report records prompt_or_path_restoration present at .messages[0].content[3].text; the marker is a phrase in the dispatch prompt read from stdin rather than memory, so the sentence is true only under a qualifier the run's own taxonomy does not supply, the same imprecision the previous review raised at line 76.
the report places the launch on the node 98d4ci-srv-2058; the fleet host is 98dci4-clu-2058 (hostname verified on the node itself), so the compute-placement record names a host that does not exist.

item_verdicts.diff: read against the parent 87806e8d commit by commit; one revision, two files, 15 insertions and 2 deletions, adding an MCP-tools paragraph to plan section 3 and a cumulative-archive section whose insertion removes nothing, with both landed HTML files parsing with no unclosed or misnested tag.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names four measured items plus the report path; all four are present, each number re-derived by me from the stored bodies (tools 46/23/5/18 against baseline 46/23/5/18 and previous fenced 20/0/0/0; bytes 257265 against 276931 and 224560; .claude.json mode 0600 with mcpServers plus claude's own first-start keys and no projects or oauth key; the git-safety marker and the worker_git_guard deny), and the report exists at the declared path.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to confirm a fenced clive worker launch carries the reckon and imas-dd MCP tools, and I re-counted the stored first-request body launch/cc-out/bodies/0001.json myself: 46 tools, 23 mcp__* (5 mcp__reckon__* including edit_plan: audit, crew, edit_plan, read_plan, roadmap; 18 mcp__imas-dd__*), with all 46 tool definitions carrying an input_schema and every mcp__* definition byte-identical to the unfenced baseline's.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names its landing revision and both arm logs, but its test_logs names launch/fenced-summary-nc.json, which does not exist on disk (the file the driver wrote is launch/fenced-summary--nc.json), and it does not disclose that the stored summary's own guard.guard_decision_key reads false while the bodies carry the deny.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the source manifest's four declared paths; the single landing revision touches docs/evidence/archive/clive-worker-profiles-landed.html (+12/-0) and docs/plans/clive-worker-profiles.html (+3/-2) only, each inside the fence, and the archive addition is a pure insertion.

justifications.durability: the measurement replays because launch/stub_tooluse.py is byte-identical to the previous run's (sha256 520b9512) and body sha256s are stored beside the numbers, but two of the three guard needles in launch/launch_fenced.py:67-71 misreport and no check in the tree reads the archive's claims back.
justifications.evidence: every number in the landed prose re-derives from a stored body (launch/cc-out/bodies/0001.json 257265 bytes, launch/cc-out--nc/bodies/0001.json 132450 bytes, 20 tools, 0 mcp__), but the record's pointer to the control arm's summary does not resolve and its stored guard.guard_decision_key contradicts the body it names.
justifications.fit: the new archive section follows the h2/strong/ul idiom of docs/evidence/archive/clive-worker-profiles-landed.html:81-93 and the message is a two-part subject and body with no attribution and no plan identifier, but the inserted paragraph sits at column 0 against its siblings' indentation and the control bullet over-claims the absence of memory markers.
justifications.goal_fidelity: launch/cc-out/bodies/0001.json carries the same 46 tools and all 23 mcp__* definitions byte-for-byte as the unfenced baseline body, plus its three built-in resource tools, so the confirmation the goal names is true of the artefact and not only of the account.
justifications.scope_discipline: docs/evidence/archive/clive-worker-profiles-landed.html:82 gains 12 lines with 0 deletions so the archive's earlier records survive, but docs/plans/clive-worker-profiles.html:26 moves plan-version from 25 to 27 although the source brief's landing contract forbids editing that line and the main checkout still reads 25.
